data.name: Fazl
data.gender_notes: Fazl is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is bestowed with blessings, or a state of being blessed. The name Fazl carries the meaning “Grace, blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Fazl usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the blessings that Allah (SWT) has bestowed upon us, and a constant reminder to give thanks and be grateful
data.etymology: Fazl belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fazl total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Ultimately, Fazl is a constant reminder to seek blessings and favors through good deeds, prayers, and devotion to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fazl means "abundance" or "blessing" in Arabic. It signifies an individual's connection to God's infinite grace and blessings, suggesting a constant remembrance of the divine source of all bounties.
